brief.headline: Russia claims Shevchenko capture, mass deep strikes; Iranian ship attack roils Caspian
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels emphasized a wave of Russian strikes on Ukrainian drone-production and logistics targets alongside the claimed capture of Shevchenko, while a Ukrainian attack on an Iranian vessel in the Caspian and the sinking of a Turkish cargo ship dominated the negative coverage.

developments.title: Channels claim capture of Shevchenko, advance toward Dobropolye
developments.body: Poddubny and Kotsnews claim the Russian Center group's 76th Airborne Division captured Shevchenko in Donetsk and is advancing toward Dobropolye, with 'heavy' Ukrainian losses. Unconfirmed and framed as part of broader gains on Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk and Kharkiv fronts.

developments.title: Coordinated messaging on strikes against Ukrainian drone plants
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed Russian missile strikes hit Ukrainian and 'Ukrainian-American' drone production facilities in Kyiv, one allegedly producing 1,000+ drones monthly, plus a Chernihiv textile plant making drone components. All claims are channel-sourced and unverified.

developments.title: Ukrainian strike on Iranian Caspian vessel draws Tehran threats
developments.body: Rybar, WarGonzo and NgP raZVedka report Ukraine attacked an Iranian cargo ship in the Caspian, with the Revolutionary Guards and Iranian FM threatening retaliation against Zelenskyy. Rybar frames it as Ukraine 'demonstrating usefulness' to the US; NgP claims an Israeli link.

developments.title: Turkish cargo ship Golden Leo sinks off Odesa
developments.body: Two Majors and Rybar report the Turkish dry cargo ship Golden Leo sank off Odesa. Rybar calls it the first vessel lost in the campaign; Two Majors attributes it to Russian missile strikes while NgP claims Russia loses 3-4 vessels daily — conflicting narratives, all unverified.

developments.title: Belgorod apartment strike causes civilian casualties
developments.body: Poddubny reports a mass Ukrainian drone attack on Belgorod injured 12 people, including two children, in an apartment building. Part of a cluster of negative posts on Ukrainian strikes on Russian regions and logistics.

developments.title: Blogger Remeslo hospitalized in psychiatric institute
developments.body: Two Majors reports pro-war blogger Remeslo, accused of spreading military falsehoods, was hospitalized in a psychiatric institute — a rare intra-milblogger criticism signal alongside NgP's sarcastic jab at Putin's maritime policy.

narrative_watch.title: Ukraine as US/Israeli proxy expanding war to Iran
narrative_watch.body: Channels frame the Caspian ship attack as Ukraine serving US Persian Gulf aims and Israeli orders, seeking to draw Iran into the conflict and internationalize the war.

narrative_watch.title: Strikes degrade Ukrainian drone/logistics capacity
narrative_watch.body: Persistent messaging that Russian precision strikes are systematically dismantling Ukrainian drone plants, rail nodes and fuel — with specific monthly-output figures to signal effectiveness.

narrative_watch.title: Migrant crackdown as domestic order restoration
narrative_watch.body: Coverage of citizenship-stripping of Tajik families and Putin's migrant-support law frames tightening migration policy as public-morale management.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant (net +100); heavy emphasis on drone-plant, fuel and rail strikes as proof of degrading Ukrainian capacity.
Positive on claimed Shevchenko capture and advances across three fronts; all claims channel-sourced and unverified.
Strongly negative (net -83); Belgorod casualties, fuel crisis and Caspian/Iran incident drive anxiety despite claimed advances.
Swung 60 points to neutral; migrant policy, marketplace strikes and navy debates dominate over triumphalism.
Neutral-to-negative; Chevron pressure over Caspian oil, US fatigue and possible decline in EU aid noted.
Sharply negative; blogger Remeslo's psychiatric hospitalization and sarcasm at Putin's maritime policy stand out.

flag_texts.title: Russia internal sentiment swings 60 points to neutral
flag_texts.body: Russia-internal net sentiment dropped to 0 (move -60), driven by neutral, unresolved coverage of the Wildberries/marketplace strikes, migrant policy laws and navy unmanned-vessel debates rather than victory framing.

flag_texts.title: Watchlist topics quiet: mobilisation and Putin criticism
flag_texts.body: No mobilisation-rumour posts appeared, and criticism of Putin remained muted — limited to NgP raZVedka's sarcastic jab at his maritime policy rather than direct attacks.
